headline: US Reactor Returns to Space for Mars Mission
captionCards: US sends nuclear reactor to Mars after 60 years
instagramCaption:
America launches a nuclear reactor into space after a 60-year hiatus.

The mission targets Mars, marking the first time the US has sent such power systems beyond Earth orbit in six decades.

This deployment aims to provide reliable energy for future deep-space exploration and potential crewed missions.
